title: Ngā Reo Whakatapua i te taha o te Poropiti
intro: I tētahi whenua tawhiti, i tūtaki tētahi karere rangatira ki te whakahē nui mai i ngā mana whakahaere o taua wā. Heoi, i tū tētahi porowhita iti o ngā wairua pono i te taha o tēnei pononga a Allah, e hiahia ana ki te whakautu i tētahi karanga atua. Mā tō rātou whakapono pakari ka wehewehea tētahi iwi kaha, ā, ka toa i ngā mana o te kore whakapono.
clues: He rōpū iti mātou i whakatapua, i kotahi i roto i te whakapono me te kaupapa.
I tū mātou i te taha o tētahi karere rangatira i whakakahoretia e ngā mana whakahaere o tō rātou whenua.
I te pātaitanga mai a tēnei karere, 'Ko wai ōku kaitautoko i te ara o Allah?' ka whakautu mātou, kāore he whakaroa.
I tono mātou ki tēnei karere kia rapu i tētahi hakari i te rangi hei whakamarie i ō mātou ngākau.
I roto i te iwi o taua wā, ko ētahi i whakapono mā roto i tā mātou karere, ko ētahi i whakakahore tonu, engari i whakakaha a Allah i te hunga whakapono.
Ko tātou te Hawwariyyun — ngā ākonga pono a Isa, i toa nā te tautoko a Allah.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Te Hawwariyyun (Nga akonga a Isa)
Ngā Hoa o te Ana

Te Whānau Ariki o Saba

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Te oati i te pono hei kaitautoko i te misioni a te poropiti
Te tiaki i roto i te moe i roto i te ana hiri
Te maka ki roto i te rua mura mō te whakapono
Te ora i tētahi wāhi whakangaromanga i a rātou e tamariki ana
Te mātakitaki i te wehenga o ngā moana i runga i te whakahau a te poropiti
trial.answer: Te oati i te pono hei kaitautoko i te misioni a te poropiti

He tokotoko i pau ai te makutu o ngā kaitukino
He ana i hiritia e te tiakitanga atua
He kamera uha i puta mai i te toka totoka
location.answer: He tēpu kua horahia ki ngā kai o te rangi

outcome.label: Hua
options: I meinga kia rangatira ake i te hunga i whakakahore i te karere
I moe marie mō ngā tau e toru rau
I whakaorangia i ngā wai o te waipuke nui
I kite i te toremitanga o tētahi rangatira tukino me tana ope taua
I kohia te koura me ngā taonga e kore e taea te tatau, engari i whakangaromia e te whakapehapeha
outcome.answer: I meinga kia rangatira ake i te hunga i whakakahore i te karere

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
